title: 2027 Gene Golub SIAM Summer School
institution: Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics (SIAM)
field: Nonlinear solvers and preconditioning techniques for multiphysics partial differential equations
about: Two-week SIAM summer school on nonlinear solvers and preconditioning techniques for multiphysics PDEs, held June 14-25, 2027 at Texas A&M University-Corpus Christi. Registration closes January 8, 2027.
requirements: Two-week school aimed at graduate students (about 40 participants per the 2027 call for proposals)
